role: Director, Office of Environmental Affairs, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare
stance_basis: letter acknowledges receipt and promises review, but follow-up paraphrase confirms no comments were ultimately submitted
summary: Charles Custard, Director of the Office of Environmental Affairs at HEW, sent an acknowledgment letter on October 9, 1975, indicating that HEW had initiated a review of the Bad Creek DEIS and would provide comments upon completion. A subsequent staff contact on January 30, 1976, with HEW's Phyllis Hayes confirmed that the agency ultimately had no comments to make on the DEIS, indicating a neutral stance with no substantive position taken.
complaint_summary: Charles Custard acknowledged receipt of the Bad Creek DEIS on behalf of HEW, stating that a departmental review had been initiated and that comments would be provided upon completion of the evaluation.

statement.text:
Thank you for your letter of September 30, 1975, to Secretary David Nathews requesting our comments on the revised draft Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) concerning the Bad Creek Project No. 2740 - South Carolina.
This Office has initiated a review of subject draft EIS by appropriate components of the Department and will provide you with our comments as soon as this evaluation is completed.
We appreciate the opportunity to review this statement.
Sincerely,
Charles Custard
Director
Office of Environmental Affairs
Charles Gunt ais
